Here are **10 creative student project ideas** that combine a **Python API (backend)** with a **web UI (frontend)**. These projects are small, practical, and great for learning full-stack development with Python and web technologies.

---

### **1. Weather Dashboard with Forecast**
**API:** Use the [OpenWeatherMap API](https://openweathermap.org/api) to fetch weather data.
**Web UI:**
- Input a city name → Display current weather, 5-day forecast, and a weather icon.
- Use **Flask/Django (backend)** + **HTML/CSS/JS (frontend)**.
- Bonus: Add a map (Leaflet.js) showing the location.

---

### **2. Movie/TV Show Recommender**
**API:** Use the [TMDB API](https://www.themoviedb.org/documentation/api) to fetch movie/TV show data.
**Web UI:**
- Search for a movie → Display details (poster, rating, plot, cast).
- "Recommend Similar" button → Shows 5 similar movies.
- Use **FastAPI (backend)** + **React/Vue.js (frontend)**.

---

### **3. GitHub Profile Analyzer**
**API:** Use the [GitHub API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest) to fetch user data.
**Web UI:**
- Input a GitHub username → Display profile stats (repos, followers, languages used).
- Show a graph of commit activity (using **Chart.js**).
- Use **Flask (backend)** + **Bootstrap (frontend)**.

---

### **4. Cryptocurrency Tracker**
**API:** Use the [CoinGecko API](https://www.coingecko.com/en/api) to fetch crypto prices.
**Web UI:**
- Display top 10 cryptocurrencies with prices, 24h change, and market cap.
- Allow users to "watch" a coin and get alerts (simulated).
- Use **FastAPI (backend)** + **Svelte (frontend)**.

---

### **5. Random Quote Generator with Favorites**
**API:** Use the [Quotable API](https://github.com/lukePeavey/quotable) or [ZenQuotes API](https://zenquotes.io/).
**Web UI:**
- Click a button → Fetch a random quote.
- Save favorite quotes to a list (stored in a **SQLite database**).
- Use **Django (backend)** + **Tailwind CSS (frontend)**.

---

### **6. NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD)**
**API:** Use the [NASA APOD API](https://api.nasa.gov/).
**Web UI:**
- Display today’s astronomy picture with title and explanation.
- Allow users to browse past APODs by date.
- Use **Flask (backend)** + **Vanilla JS (frontend)**.

---

### **7. Joke Generator with Categories**
**API:** Use the [JokeAPI](https://v2.jokeapi.dev/) or [Dad Jokes API](https://icanhazdadjoke.com/api).
**Web UI:**
- Select a joke category (e.g., programming, pun, dark humor).
- Display a random joke and allow users to rate it (thumbs up/down).
- Use **FastAPI (backend)** + **Alpine.js (frontend)**.

---

### **8. Stock Market Simulator (Fake Trading)**
**API:** Use the [Alpha Vantage API](https://www.alphavantage.co/) or [Yahoo Finance API](https://www.yahoofinanceapi.com/).
**Web UI:**
- Simulate buying/selling stocks with fake money.
- Display a portfolio with current value and profit/loss.
- Use **Django (backend)** + **React (frontend)**.

---

### **9. Meme Generator**
**API:** Use the [Imgflip API](https://imgflip.com/api) to fetch meme templates.
**Web UI:**
- Select a meme template → Add custom text → Generate and download the meme.
- Use **Flask (backend)** + **HTML Canvas (frontend)**.

---

### **10. Language Translator with History**
**API:** Use the [Google Translate API](https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs) (free tier) or [LibreTranslate](https://libretranslate.com/).
**Web UI:**
- Input text → Select source/target language → Display translation.
- Save translation history in a **SQLite database**.
- Use **FastAPI (backend)** + **Vue.js (frontend)**.

---

### **Tech Stack Suggestions:**
| **Backend (API)** | **Frontend (Web UI)** | **Database (Optional)** |
|-------------------|----------------------|------------------------|
| Flask             | HTML/CSS/JS          | SQLite                 |
| FastAPI           | React/Vue/Svelte     | PostgreSQL             |
| Django            | Bootstrap/Tailwind   | Firebase               |

---

### **Why These Projects?**
✅ **Small & Manageable** – Can be built in a weekend.
✅ **API Integration** – Teaches HTTP requests, JSON parsing, and error handling.
✅ **Web UI** – Covers frontend basics (forms, dynamic content, styling).
✅ **Portfolio-Worthy** – Great for GitHub and resumes.

Would you like a **step-by-step guide** for any of these? 🚀
